name: Johannes Schröcken
source:
Efficient and intelligent, Johannes is a skilled butler and valet employed under the Wrights. A former doctor from Germany, murmurs about murder and other morbid theories surround him. 

When he's not working, however, he is a domestic man who enjoys the company of his husband and their two daughters.

[From [url=https://www.castingcall.club/projects/paid-see-submission-guidelines-the-letter-a-horror-visual-novel]Castingcall.club[/url]]
